科研.title: 添加一名代理人：人工智能团队规模和阵型如何影响人类-人工智能头脑风暴团队的生产力和多样性
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.26663v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Generative AI has improved individual productivity, but whether adding a plurality of AI partners helps or hurts remains open. We crossed AI partnership (one versus two) with behavioral formation (calibrated to average human behavior versus customized by the participant) in a brainstorming experiment ($N$=168) with human-human dyads as reference. Two-AI rooms posted more ideas to the shared board, but human-authored ideas dropped substantially. With one AI partner, formation mattered: humans paired with an average-calibrated AI posted more than any other condition. With two, this effect vanished. Humans continued talking but converted fewer ideas into board posts. AI social talk predicted more human posts, while AI posting volume predicted fewer. AI presence increased global diversity of human-authored ideas, but only a second AI increased within-session differentiation. The number of AI partners and their formation can reshape what the human contributes; single-agent results do not generalize to multi-agent teams.

科研.title: 构建一致性：综合 CTI 知识图和一致性验证的形式限制
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.26717v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Synthesizing relational training data such as knowledge graphs with a large language model typically emits structured objects one at a time, which keeps each object valid but leaves the relationships between them ungrounded. We study an alternative paradigm, generation by simulation: rather than describing a relational artifact, we simulate a process that produces it and take the artifact to be its causal record. Language-model agents propose intent and a deterministic referee resolves outcomes against an explicit world model, so a relation is emitted only when the event it represents occurs, making coherence a property of construction. We instantiate the paradigm for cyber threat intelligence knowledge graphs in the STIX 2.1 standard with three engines, among them an evolutionary engine applying language-model genetic operators to structured graph genomes, sharing a deterministic compiler that makes malformed and dangling output unrepresentable. We prove referential closure, causal grounding, and identifier stability, an ablation localizes each to the referee and world model rather than the policy, and two independent LLM judges reproduce the rubric's engine ranking. Our central result is cautionary, and we prove it: a validator reading any graph feature set a structure-matched random graph can reproduce is uninformative about coherence for a coherence-by-construction generator. Using Erd\H{o}s-R\'enyi controls we realize the theorem four times, as structural separation, embedding transfer, inductive link prediction, and real-data augmentation each reward a triviality rather than coherence; we give the mechanism behind each and the conditions a valid benchmark must meet.

科研.title: TOUMAII：450 万对工具调用偏好数据集及其与源无关的生成器
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.26722v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: To autonomously execute multi-step tasks, enterprise agents must reliably interact with tools, call APIs, or query databases, making tool-calling a fundamental capability of AI models. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) optimises for producing the correct call, but never contrasts it with a plausible incorrect one. In an environment where even a minor formatting error can invalidate a call and an incorrect decision can derail the interaction, direct preference optimisation (DPO) targets exactly this contrast. DPO, therefore, requires preference pairs rather than plain demonstrations. For tool-calling, such data, especially in realistic multi-turn settings, remains extremely scarce. To address this scarcity, we introduce TOUMAII, a large-scale tool-calling preference dataset containing ~4.5M validated preference pairs, derived from Agent-Ark/Toucan-1.5M (apache-2.0) conversations. The dataset consists of multi- and single-turn interactions and includes parallel and sequential function calls. Additionally, we release TOUMAII-Gen, a synthetic data generation pipeline that consumes tool-calling SFT datasets and generates a preference dataset with naturally occurring model-generated tool-calling failure modes. To validate the effectiveness of our DPO data, we fine-tune a 3-billion-parameter model, achieving performance parity with other high-quality tool-calling preference datasets. Furthermore, we release a second small preference dataset derived from ToolACE (apache-2.0), showcasing the source-agnostic nature of our pipeline. We release the complete code and datasets: https://github.com/tum-ai/toumaii-gen and https://huggingface.co/collections/tum-ai/toumaii-generated-datasets

科研.title: ChatAtom：用于分子动力学模拟和可视化的多代理法学硕士系统
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.26782v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Molecular dynamics (MD) simulation resolves atomic-scale motion and predicts the structural, mechanical, and dynamic properties of materials, making it cen- tral to materials design and discovery. Yet an MD study requires an expert-driven workflow: designing the simulation, writing reliable input scripts, executing them, and analyzing the results with separate tools. Here we present ChatAtom, a multi-agent large language model system that translates a natural-language request into a complete MD workflow without the user writing input scripts or analysis code. Each agent has a defined responsibility within the workflow. An orchestrator plans the study; the LAMMPS and OVITO agents each use a generator-reviewer pair to prepare and review simulation and visualization scripts before execution; a high-performance computing agent dispatches jobs to remote resources; and an analysis agent interprets the completed run. The work- flow is accessible through a browser interface that streams thermodynamic data and rendered frames during local execution, allowing users to follow the simu- lation as it progresses. The architecture also supports new capabilities through loadable skills without modifying the agents, enabling autonomous hypothesis generation and testing. We evaluate ChatAtom through script-generation bench- marks, an end-to-end study of crack propagation, and a closed-loop campaign. By bringing script generation, execution, visualization, and analysis into one reviewed and observable pipeline, ChatAtom lowers the barrier to conducting MD studies and broadens access to advanced simulation workflows.

科研.title: 关于线性神经网络的损失情况：超越临界点
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.26671v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: While the critical points of the loss landscape in linear neural networks have been extensively studied since the seminal work of Baldi \& Hornik in the late 1980s, a description of this landscape at an intermediate or global scale is still lacking. Such a characterization is crucial, particularly as a substantial body of literature indicates that gradient descent circumvents critical points. The present article introduces an intermediate structure, termed the critical thalweg, which encompasses all critical points and exhibits key geometric properties. Beyond providing a geometric proof of Baldi \& Hornik's results using simpler assumptions than the existing literature, this framework offers a global view of the loss landscape that can be easily visualized in a two-dimensional plane. Empirical observations suggest that gradient descent is attracted toward the critical thalweg, along which the loss continues to decrease to its global minimum.

科研.title: 寄生虫特征：通过虚假途径进行因果抽象
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.26711v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Causal Abstraction defines a notion of \emph{equivalence} between a neural network and an algorithm, thus serving as a powerful framework for mechanistic interpretability. In this paper, however, we show the existence of a class of \emph{spurious features} which straightforwardly pass such equivalence tests. Suppose there are two directions in a model's representation space where: (i) one discriminates the input based on some feature, and (ii) the other steers the model towards a certain output. Interpretability methods based on Causal Abstraction (e.g., Distributed Alignment Search) can \emph{spuriously} simulate these directions' combined behavior by leveraging pathways passing through them, giving the impression that the model implements this feature. In such cases, we say the method discovered a \defn{parasite feature}. Experimentally, we show that Distributed Alignment Search finds parasite features using linear alignment maps in two tasks: syntactic agreement and two-digit addition. Our paper highlights an important consideration for Causal Abstraction and contributes to the ongoing debate about best practices for mechanistic interpretability.

科研.title: 联邦学习的交叉攻击鲁棒聚合
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.26731v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Federated learning (FL) lets resource-constrained IoT and edge devices train a shared model without exchanging raw data, but compromised or faulty devices can poison the global model. Existing robust aggregators each fail in some regime: naive averaging (FedAvg) collapses under high-magnitude attacks, whereas distance- and statistics-based defenses (Krum, median, trimmed mean) sacrifice accuracy on non-IID data and remain vulnerable to stealthy attacks. We present FedTether, which reweights client updates by their deviation from a coordinatewise median through a robust, dead-zoned score applied as a server-side optimizer step. Across three datasets, three attack types, and Byzantine fractions up to 40%, FedTether is the only method top-tier in every regime: it matches FedAvg under stealthy attacks with no robustness tax, exceeds robust baselines by up to 42 accuracy points, and stays accurate where high-magnitude attacks reduce FedAvg to near-random. These properties persist at 50 clients under partial participation, with no shared data or validation set.

科研.title: 用于多模式检索和生成的深度链接剩余令牌
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.26752v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Iterative architectures such as looped language models improve parameter efficiency and reasoning capacity of transformers, yet their sequential backbone iterations introduce substantial computational latency. Conversely, parallelizable learnable special tokens (such as the register tokens in Vision Transformer) enable efficient single-pass inference, but often suffer from the absence of sequential refinement and exhibit redundant representations across tokens. To address these challenges, we introduce Depth-Linked Residual Tokens (DepThink), an efficient framework designed for multimodal retrieval and generation. Operating within a single pre-filling forward pass, DepThink appends a sequence of K learnable residual tokens whose hidden states are coupled through a lightweight, learnable residual recurrence. This mechanism enables each residual token to progressively capture complementary information missed by preceding tokens. Theoretically, we prove that DepThink provides strictly expanded geometric directional reachability over standard learnable tokens and guarantees a provable one-step descent advantage. We evaluate DepThink across multimodal retrieval and generation tasks. DepThink consistently outperforms learnable-token baselines and matches or exceeds looped architectures across dense (2B, 8B) and sparse mixture-of-experts (30B-A3B) backbones under both LoRA and full-parameter fine-tuning, while accelerating training by up to 11.9 and inference by 4.3 over looped architectures.

科研.title: 任意晶体对称性多晶弹性波的统一闭式理论
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.26674v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The coherent elastic wave in random polycrystals is described by the first-order smoothing approximation, whose mass operator remains an integral evaluated only numerically. Here we derive its closed form for equiaxed, untextured polycrystals of any crystal symmetry with an exponential correlation function, giving an explicit dispersion equation at all frequencies. Unlike the integral form, which fails beyond one inverse correlation radius from the real axis, the closed form holds deep in the complex wavenumber plane, where heavily attenuated roots lie. It is compact, reproduces the dispersion equations of Stanke and Kino for cubic grains, extends them to any symmetry and contains the Born and far-field approximations as special cases. It reveals the structure of the roots and their partitions of the coherent field: three roots per polarization, one from the incident wave and one from each of the two scattering channels, without and with mode conversion. It also yields closed-form limits of their velocity, attenuation and partition in the Rayleigh, stochastic and geometric regimes, which show why a single coherent wave has been observed at long wavelengths, whereas more than one can be observed at short wavelengths. These results underpin further theory and quantitative characterization of polycrystalline microstructure.

科研.title: 当磁力定理失效时：感应力矩磁体 FePt、FePd、CoPt 和 CoPd 中的交换
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.26697v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Effective spin Hamiltonians for itinerant magnets are commonly parameterized by magnetic-force-theorem (MFT) exchange constants, which are subsequently used to compute the behavior of complex and delicate spin textures, for example skyrmions. We show that for systems containing atoms with large spin susceptibility, such as Pd or Pt, this approach misses important parts of the energetics. For FePt, it even predicts the wrong ground state. Benchmarking against fully self-consistent spin-spiral density-functional calculations - in which the electronic structure, including the induced Pd/Pt moments, relaxes for every spin configuration - we quantify the missing energetics for the ordered L1$_0$ alloys FePt, FePd, CoPt, and CoPd. By comparing a family of models that differ only in their treatment of the induced Pt moment, including the configuration-dependent models of Mryasov and Polesya, we identify the origin: the energetics of the induced moments are governed by the exchange-enhanced (dressed) susceptibility, of which the frozen-potential MFT captures only the bare part - about one third of the Pt-mediated interaction in FePt. We derive a general bound showing that no on-site (intra-atomic) refinement can supply the missing strength. The dressing decides the magnetic ground state in FePt, where the interlayer ordering rests entirely on the Pt-mediated interactions, and shifts the Curie temperatures of the other alloys by several hundred kelvin. Computed ordering temperatures, magnon spectra and spin wave stiffness for all four compounds are provided.

科研.title: 通过交替 O$_2$ 和 H$_2$/SF$_6$ 等离子体暴露对铌进行原子层蚀刻
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.26735v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Niobium thin films are a key component of superconducting detectors and electronics, and film surface quality, surface roughness, and geometrical dimensional accuracy affect many performance metrics. Atomic layer etching (ALE) is of interest for modifying film surfaces owing to its Angstrom-scale etching precision and surface smoothing characteristics. Here, we report a plasma-enhanced ALE process for Nb based on sequential O$_2$ plasma and H$_2$/SF$_6$ plasma exposures. The process achieves an etch per cycle of 5-7 Angstrom/cycle and exhibits surface smoothing. The superconducting transition temperature of the ALE-treated films is maintained up to the expected decrease associated with reduced film thickness. Our ALE process could find applications in superconducting electronics for which surface quality and precise thickness control are of high importance.

科研.title: 通过机器学习和传递函数校准预测半赫斯勒化合物的晶格热导率
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.26788v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: High-throughput searches for half-Heusler thermoelectrics increasingly rely on lattice thermal conductivity ($\kappa_L$) from first-principles calculations, or from machine-learning models trained on them. These calculations describe an ideal single crystal, whereas measurements are made on polycrystalline samples, in which grain boundaries and defects scatter heat as well. The resulting gap between calculated and measured $\kappa_L$ has been noted for individual compounds but not, to our knowledge, quantified across a materials class, so the values used for screening carry an unknown, systematic bias. Here we quantify and correct this bias for cubic half-Heusler compounds with 18 valence electrons. Using a curated literature corpus that keeps calculated and measured values apart, we show that calculations overestimate measured $\kappa_L$ in most bonding families, and that the excess shrinks with temperature. Scattering by defects, added to the intrinsic scattering between lattice vibrations, would give such a trend, but the data do not single out one cause. A simple transfer function with this temperature dependence removes the median offset, and refitting its magnitude within a bonding family lowers the median error further, though not consistently compound by compound. Combined with a machine-learning model that predicts the calculated value from crystal structure, and tested on chemistries withheld from all fitting, the method predicts measured $\kappa_L$ in this class about as closely as independent laboratories agree with one another, and provides testable predictions for compounds not yet measured.

科研.title: 具有 100,000 次旋转单次并行读出功能的空间复用光电伊辛机
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.26915v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ising machines offer a promising route to solving NP-hard combinatorial optimization problems by mapping them onto the ground state of the Ising model. Free-space optical implementations are attractive for their inherent parallelism, scalability, and energy efficiency, yet nearly all rely on individual, sequential spin updates, leaving most of this parallelism unexploited. Here, we reclaim it with a free-space optical analog Ising machine built from off-the-shelf components in which every spin is addressed in parallel and read out in a single camera shot, while letting the system evolve under analog dynamics rather than being written and read one spin at a time. We demonstrate this architecture with over 100,000 spins, the largest spatially multiplexed analog Ising machine reported to date, with a realistic path beyond one million spins limited only by spatial-light-modulator and camera resolution. Across sparse and dense MaxCut and fully connected number-partitioning instances, our machine matches state-of-the-art solution quality. Because every spin updates in parallel, throughput increases with system size, unlike time-multiplexed machines, which slow as problems grow. The same free-space geometry also lets us solve more than 50 problem instances simultaneously, further boosting throughput. Together, these results mark an important step towards a scalable, and energy-efficient Ising machine.

科研.title: 基于振镜的飞秒激光体积显示器
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.26928v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Femtosecond-laser-induced plasma enables self-emissive voxels to be generated directly in air for drawing three-dimensional images. Galvanometer-mirror-based beam scanning provides a method for rapidly moving plasma voxels using a relatively simple optical configuration. However, the generated plasma voxels are not ideal points but luminous regions with finite lengths and widths. Variations in voxel shape and orientation caused by focusing and scanning conditions may therefore affect the appearance of rendered points and lines. Nevertheless, quantitative relationships between focusing and scanning conditions and plasma-voxel geometry remain insufficiently characterized in systems using a two-axis galvanometer mirror and a single focusing lens. Here, we quantitatively investigate how focal length and two-axis galvanometer scan angle affect the shape of plasma voxels and the projected inclination of their principal axes. For focal lengths ranging from 75 to 300 mm, the mean plasma length increased from 1.39 to 4.64 mm. These results indicate that increasing the focal length produces more elongated and anisotropic plasma voxels. The projected inclination of the plasma principal axis varied approximately linearly with the corresponding scan angle, although the response differed between the two scanning axes. These results provide quantitative design data for selecting focusing conditions and correcting voxel shape and orientation according to scanning conditions in galvanometer-mirror-based aerial volumetric displays.

科研.title: 导电聚合物枝晶的萌芽场作为不断发展的有机电化学框架以互连电极阵列
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.27480v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Balancing high performance with sustainability in microelectronics is challenged by energy-intensive processes, scarce materials and limited recyclability. Inspired by nature, a promising solution relies on the evolution of the foundry model to transient microelectronics, using electrochemistry to grow adaptive circuits on demand and during operation. To this end, this study explores how to harness the morphogenesis of conducting polymer dendrites between stacks of micro-electrode arrays to dynamically interconnect them with voltage pulses. Using propylene carbonate as a solvent, we investigated the dynamics of the electroconvective growth of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) (PEDOT), revealing strong structural dependencies between the morphology of the electrogenerated polymer and the confinement of the micro-electrodes. As the system evolves from 2D flat patterns to 3D dendritic structures, the capability of the conducting polymer to locally interconnect specific nodes heavily depends on the size and density of the arrays which directly impact the flow distribution during growth. By unraveling how a device geometry enables the growth of dendritic interconnections on integrated micro-electrode arrays, the morphogenesis of conducting polymer dendrites not only addresses the longstanding issue of heterogeneous integration in microelectronics, but also opens the way to a paradigm where electronic devices learn as they grow in our pockets.

科研.title: 空心光纤中的 SOP 传感：使用 COTS 转发器进行前向传感并使用相干 OTDR 进行定位

科技.title: 字节，该造手机了
科技.summary: 11 月 19 日，财联社援引供应链人士的消息称，富士康旗下的富智康已经拿到 OpenAI 手机的组装订单，首款产品有望在 2027 年底或 2028 年面市。OpenAI 至今没有确认自己在做手机，但从今年 4 月起，围绕这台手机的供应链消息就没有断过。 而在中国，一家 AI 公司的手机其实已经卖到了第二代，这就是豆包手机。只不过在这台手机上，让助手帮你叫一辆车已经不算难事，但想让它接着给朋友回一条「我上车了」的微信，目前还做不到。 按曹操出行公布的用法，看到想去的地方，按一下手机侧面的 AI 键，豆包就能认出屏幕上的地址，路线和车型也都可以在对话里选。但等你上了车，它却没办法替你在微信里点下「发送」。 车之所以叫得到，是因为曹操出行把服务直接接给了豆包。微信并没有这么做：它和淘宝、美团一起，被列在豆包手机助手 10 月 14 日公布的一份清单里。清单上的应用超过 150 款，都不允许豆包代替用户在自己的页面上操作。 豆包公示的拒绝操作清单节选｜图片来源：豆包手机助手 要知道，这已经是第二代豆包手机了。去年 12 月，第一代努比亚 M153 还只是少量发售的工程样机，售价 3499 元。彼时豆包的说法是，自己没有自研手机的计划，正在和多家手机厂商洽谈合作。 到了今年 9 月，面向普通消费者的努比亚 NaviX Ultra 上市，5999 元起。但一年过去，市面上能买到的豆包手机，仍然只出自中兴旗下的努比亚。 两代产品做下来，字节缺的已经不是模型，也不是愿意陪它试一试的伙伴，而是一家自己说了算的手机厂：豆包手机一年能卖多少台、下一代还做不做，现在都由合作的手机厂决定。而台数上不去，字节也就没有筹码，让微信这样的应用坐下来谈。 手机厂不让的生态位 豆包手机助手想做的事，说白了就是替用户在一个个 App 之间把事情办完，而要做到这一点，靠的是一项系统级的权限。去年 12 月首代样机发售后，豆包手机助手在 M153 上第一次拥有了名为 INJECT_EVENTS 的系统级权限。有了它，助手才能像手指一样在屏幕上点按、滑动。 豆包当时的回应是，这确实是系统级权限，有更严格的使用限制。按澎湃报道里技术人员的分析，有这项权限的助手，没法从应用商店下载后装到任意一台手机上，必须和手机深度绑定。一位业内人士也提到，小米的小爱、荣耀的 YOYO 这些手机厂自己的助手，同样拥有这项权限。 换句话说，豆包要的其实是手机厂留给自家助手的那个位置，也就是按下侧键后出来的系统助手。到了第二代，豆包和系统绑得更紧了：按中兴的介绍，NaviX Ultra 的 AI 键做进了指纹识别，一部分交给豆包的任务，在锁屏之后还能接着做。而这类功能，做手机的人在画设计图、定系统功能的时候，就得和做助手的人坐在一起商量。 第二代豆包手机努比亚 NaviX Ultra｜图片来源：中兴通讯 但问题在于，这个位置，有销量的手机厂并不肯让，它们目前愿意做的，更多是向外面的公司借模型。荣耀今年 9 月成了阿里 Qwen Intelligence 的首个合作伙伴，双方一起开发手机上的模型和方案，但用户开口喊的还是 YOYO。 苹果也是类似的做法：国行 Apple 智能 11 月 4 日面向开发者开放测试，Siri 会把一部分问题转交给千问，回答里带着千问的标识，但用户先叫的还是 Siri。 Siri 把问题转交给千问｜图片来源：极客公园 阿里在这两家那里，都只是模型的供应商，所以进得去。当然，字节如果只当供应商，同样进得去：去年 10 月荣耀发布 Magic8 系列时，YOYO 的联网问答和识图就用上了豆包大模型。它真正进不去的，是系统助手这个位置。 字节也不是没有找过别家。除了中兴，字节还接触过小米、OPPO、vivo、荣耀、联想和传音，谈过的方案里，有一种就是用豆包替换手机厂原来的助手。 但显然很少有手机厂会愿意将自己的核心数据和服务分发权出让给互联网大厂。这也不难理解，助手会替用户决定叫哪家的车、点哪家的外卖，一旦把这个位置拱手让给别人，手机厂在这些服务上也就说不上话了。 更何况，手机厂自己的助手，也确实办得了同样的事。曹操出行 9 月 14 日宣布接入豆包手机助手，15 日宣布接入荣耀 YOYO，17 日又在 OPPO 开发者大会上演示了接入内测版小布 Next 的打车服务，同一家打车公司，四天里就接了三个助手。既然自家助手一样叫得到车，手机厂自然也就没有理由把侧键让给豆包。 曹操出行四天里的三份公告｜图片来源：曹操出行 所以到头来，愿意把系统助手整个交给豆包的，往往只会是更需要一个「故事」的手机厂，而这样的手机厂，销量通常也不大。豆包手机 2026 年整体备货约 20 万台，这还是一款机型一整年的量。作为对比，按 IDC 的统计，中国市场光是今年第三季度，就出货了约 5790 万台智能手机。 这点量，显然还换不来微信和淘宝开门。像曹操出行这样想多一个获客渠道的应用，哪家助手都愿意接。 但对微信和淘宝来说，AI 替用户点按，会绕过 App 自己的页面和广告位，它们守的是自己的分发权，背后的腾讯和阿里又是字节的对手，也就没有理由为了一年 20 万台手机，让别人家的助手进到自己的页面里点按。退一步说，量大了它们也未必就会开门，但量这么小，字节连坐下来谈的筹码都没有。 更现实的问题是，这种合作本身也算不上牢靠。据知情人士介绍，中兴同样也在评估其他模型和合作方案，并没有把长期的 AI 路线完全绑在豆包身上。也就是说，下一代豆包手机做不做、什么时候做，字节一家定不了。 当然，再找一家有销量的手机厂合作，是最容易想到的办法。 据传已经有另一家手机大厂和豆包的手机合作项目，即将在 11 月内正式落地。 但按照前面提到的分工，有销量的手机厂就算愿意合作，更可能拿出来的也只是一款单独的合作机型，旗舰上的系统助手还是会留给自己。至于合作机型做不做下一代、系统更新排在哪一天，同样由对方说了算。 于是就有了眼下的局面，愿意把系统助手交给豆包的手机厂没有销量，而有销量的手机厂，又只肯向外借模型。 握在自己手里 类似的处境，国内的互联网大厂并不陌生，百度早就在汽车上经历过一遍。 2017 年 4 月，百度宣布 Apollo 计划，把自动驾驶的软件平台开放给车企，时任百度总裁陆奇把它比作「自动驾驶的安卓」。 彼时合作伙伴的名单很长，但自动驾驶恰恰是车企最不愿意交给别人的那一环，这和今天手机厂护着系统助手，是一个道理。四年后百度选择自己下场造车，某种程度上也说明这条路并没有走通。 2021 年 3 月，百度和吉利成立集度，自己占 55% 的股份。到了 2023 年 8 月，集度改组为极越，吉利占 65%，百度降到 35%。2024 年 12 月，极越停摆。百度的这段经历说明，只做系统那一环拿不到车，但即便自己控股造车，也并不保证就能做成。 百度的持股从 55% 降到了 35%｜图片来源：极越 不过平心而论，字节的条件要比当年的百度好不少：手机的产业链已经相当成熟，一台手机的成本和迭代周期都远低于一辆车，努比亚也已经陪它做了两代。按 QuestMobile 今年上半年的报告，豆包 App 的月活跃用户有 3.82 亿，虽然他们用的只是装在别家手机里的一个 App，还算不上豆包手机的用户，但至少是一批现成的潜在买家。 更重要的是，想把手机握在自己手里的 AI 公司，不只字节一家。前面提到的那台 OpenAI 手机，按天风国际分析师郭明錤的说法，立项的理由就是要交付完整的智能体服务，得同时掌控操作系统和硬件。如果这些消息属实，OpenAI 要的同样是一台自己说了算的手机。 从这个角度看，字节某种程度上就是中国的 OpenAI：豆包是中国用户最多的 AI 应用，它同样想让自己的助手直接替用户操作手机，而且已经做到了第二代。 ChatGPT 并不在中国大陆提供服务，OpenAI 的手机大概率也进不来，但它一旦发布，「AI 公司自己做手机」就不再是新鲜事，中国的手机厂只会把系统助手看得更紧。字节显然想赶在那之前，先在中国把类似的位置占下来。只不过，OpenAI 从一开始选的就是自己造，而字节眼下的这个位置，还是从努比亚那里借来的。 如果字节真要把一家手机厂握在手里，全资收购也好，控股也罢，最要紧的是产品和排期由它自己说了算。这样一来，这一代留下的问题，就可以直接排进下一代手机的设计和系统更新，不用等对方点头；备多少货、定什么价、要不要为了多卖一些少赚一点，也都由它自己定。 事实上，市场上已经有类似的传闻。其中一个版本，是把中兴的手机业务打包，由中兴、某互联网大厂和地方国资成立合资公司。11 月 3 日，中兴公开否认了这个方案，回应里没有点名字节。至于字节收购努比亚，截至发稿也没有任何交易方确认，这些目前都还只能是传闻。 但即便握住了一家手机厂，也只是拿到了入场的资格，毕竟字节自己做硬件的记录并不好看：2019 年它接手了锤子科技的手机团队，2021 年 1 月就暂停了手机业务；2021 年收购的 VR 公司 Pico，到 2023 年 11 月也大幅裁员。 只不过那两次，字节手里都没有一样离了自家硬件就做不成的东西。豆包手机助手不一样，它要的系统权限，只有手机厂给得了。 至于微信和淘宝那扇门，自然也不会因为字节有了手机厂就自己打开。11 月 6 日，工信部公布智能体终端设备进网管理通知，要求应用分发平台推动开发者用电子签名表明是否同意智能体调用，应用没有声明同意，智能体不得强制调用。 也就是说，这扇门最终还是只能靠谈。而字节能摆上桌的筹码，是有多少人在用豆包手机；真正肯为豆包把这个数字做大的，恐怕也只有它自己的手机厂。 当然，有了自己的手机厂，豆包手机也不一定就做得成。但如果没有，那条「我上车了」的微信，用户大概还得自己发很久。

科技.title: CachyOS 支持 Easy Anti-Cheat v2
科技.summary: 基于 Arch Linux、专注于高性能优化的发行版 CachyOS 释出了最新版本 CachyOS November 2026，主要变化是为需要运行反作弊工具的 Linux 多人游戏提供了 Easy Anti-Cheat v2 支持。其它变化包括：用于回滚受损系统的新恢复环境 cachyos-recovery；引入新 UI 的 CachyOS Package Installer v2；取代 KMS 和 nvidia-module-loader 的 cachyos-drm-awaiter，确保在显示管理器启动前已完成加载 GPU 驱动；等等。
